newsitem.title: USA: AT&T says Edward Dwyer vice president and treasurer. [CORRECTED 20:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: AT&T says Edward Dwyer vice president and treasurer. [CORRECTED 20:00 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline to read appointment as vice president rather than president.)
AT&T Corp said Monday Edward Dwyer was appointed vice president and treasurer effective May 22.
Dwyer is currently vice president and chief financial officer of the recently sold AT&T Capital Corp. At&T Capital Cor said Ramon Oliu Jr. will replace Dwyer.
AT&T Capital said Oliu is the company's controller. Dwyer replaces S. Lawrence Prendergast, who will become chairman and chief executive officer of AT&T Investment Management Corp.
The company said Prendergast succeeds David Feldman, who retired from AT&T earlier this year to pursue other interests.
AT&T Capital, formerly majority owned by AT&T, is now a privately held company.
